scripts.features:
--> Released: Arcane Odyssey Auto Chest Farm was released
--> Features:
--> Webhook: You can set up your webhook with the "getgenv().webhooklink" variable. With this feature you can see which items you've collected, even if you're not currently seeing the instance. With this feature, there is also the "getgenv().ping" variable, where you put your Discord ID, and you're also going to get pinged whenever you've collected a new item. (this can be used to track how many items you've totally collected since last time you checked the channel)
--> NOTE: All the other features are the exact same as in the item farm, that's why they're not mentioned. Also, because this script uses another method to collect, it's less risky than the item farm.

--> IMPORTANT <--
The AutoChest farm is bound to eventually stop farming, because of your player dying of starvation, fixes will come in the near future. Thanks for using HsB
